name: TrendRiderStrategy (bull pullback to EMA w/ ADX, OBV, BTC & Fear-Greed filters)
author: unknown (not stated in file)
indicators: EMA(multi), EMA50/200, RSI, ADX(14), +DI/-DI, MACD, BB, OBV and OBV EMA, volume_ratio, BTC RSI 1h, Fear&Greed index, daily EMA200
entry_long: is_bull AND pullback_to_ema AND RSI in (low,high) AND ADX>thr AND volume_ratio>f AND +DI>-DI AND OBV>OBV_ema AND BTC_RSI_1h>35 AND 25<=FNG<=85 AND RSI<70 AND close>EMA200_1d
implementation_notes: Requires external Fear&Greed data (free API) - mark data dependency. Multiple entry tags (trend_pullback, ema50...). Not fully captured. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
